items.title: Bitcoin faces U.S. CPI test as analysts warn inflation relief may not be enough
items.summary: Bitcoin trades below $75,000 ahead of the October inflation data. Analysts warning that sustainable recovery depends on improving liquidity and spot ETF demand rather than temporary macro relief.

items.title: Bitcoin in Limbo as Stocks Rebound Ahead of US Inflation Report
items.summary: U.S. stocks rallied as oil fell, but Bitcoin hovered near $75,000 after a wave of liquidations, with Tuesday's inflation report set to test bets on a December Fed rate hike.

items.title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
items.summary: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

items.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
items.summary: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

items.title: MARA posts $634 million Q3 net profit on bitcoin gains, sells 13,597 BTC to pay off loans
items.summary: MARA posted a $634.4 million Q3 net profit, then sold 13,597 BTC to repay $750 million in loans as it pivots to AI.

items.title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
items.summary: Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end.

items.title: Binance to Close Accounts in Four EU Countries Dec. 31, Charging Idle Balances From Nov. 29
items.summary: Binance told users in France, Spain, Italy and Poland to withdraw their crypto, with deposits already blocked and accounts set to close by year end.

items.title: Amundi puts European stocks on Ethereum, but access terms stay hidden
items.summary: The share class announced Nov. 5 represents fund units, while Amundi's release leaves investor access, transfer and redemption terms unspecified.

items.title: HIVE, MARA mine more Bitcoin but earn less as crypto prices fall
items.summary: Both miners reported higher Bitcoin production but lower mining revenue and rising electricity costs as they expanded their AI infrastructure businesses.

items.title: Trump Media swings to $410 million profit in Q3, driven by crypto gains
items.summary: Trump Media and Technology Group reported a net income of $409.7 million in Q3, compared with a net loss of $54.8 million a year earlier.

items.title: Binance Hack Launderers Mint Elon Musk and Animal Meme Coins to Move Stolen Crypto
items.summary: Elliptic says the hackers are minting their own worthless tokens and routing stolen funds through liquidity pools.

items.title: BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT
items.summary: BlackRock's Robbie Mitchnick told Barron's demand to swap directly held bitcoin for IBIT shares is a response to security concerns.

items.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
items.summary: A recent Bitcoin block approached a 2015 transaction count record but generated only $180 in fees.

items.title: Binance CFO leaves the company to tokenize real assets
items.summary: Ng says the transition took months and describes tokenization interests after five years as CFO, without naming a venture.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation, Vitalik Buterin sued over firing after suicide pledge dispute
items.summary: Fulton's complaint cites a recorded Buterin conversation and alleges discrimination and retaliation.

items.title: Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking
items.summary: A Warren banking aide says the incoming Senate Banking chair will target prediction markets.

items.title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
items.summary: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries.

items.title: Google Takes Aim at Nvidia With New AI Chips Built for Privacy and Massive Memory
items.summary: Google's TPU 8tx protects sensitive AI workloads, while the dual-chip TPU 8i Max targets memory-hungry AI agents.

items.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX-ICE platform even as most companies opt out
items.summary: Robinhood supports tokenization of its stock on the OKX-ICE platform.

items.title: Canada opens bank stablecoin access, but strips deposit guarantees
items.summary: Budget 2026 proposes bringing bank subsidiaries and foreign financial institutions outside Canadian prudential supervision under the Stablecoin Act.
